output_list.criticism: The function addguess() has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows users to guess, and it can be triggered to overflow the numguesses variable, which is used to index the guesses array. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to become a winner.

The function _addguess() has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows users to guess, and it can be triggered to overflow the numguesses variable, which is used to index the guesses array. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to become a winner.

The function setBettingCondition() has a wrong logic vulnerability. It allows the developer to set the arraysize and bettingprice, but it does not check if the arraysize is larger than 1000. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to make the arraysize larger than 1000, which can lead to integer overflow in the addguess function.

The function findWinner() has a bad randomness vulnerability. It uses a predictable value (lotterynumber) to determine the winner, which can be manipulated by attackers. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to become a winner.
The function simplelottery() has a typo in the constructor, which is not a real constructor. It can be exploited by attackers to set developer address and initial state.
